title: Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic news due in 2027
subject: fateoftheoldrepublic
description:
What do you want to see first from Fate of the Old Republic? 👇

Director Casey Hudson said on The Fourth Curtain podcast that Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic, the spiritual successor to Knights of the Old Republic revealed at The Game Awards 2025, will have news early next year. No release date or platforms have been announced.

Sources: GamesRadar+ (Nov 15, 2026), Yahoo Tech (Nov 15, 2026)

scenes.text: Fate of the Old Republic has news coming in 2027.
Director Casey Hudson said so on The Fourth Curtain podcast, as GamesRadar reported on November 15.
His words: you won't have to wait too long into next year.
It's the spiritual successor to Knights of the Old Republic, revealed at The Game Awards in December 2025.
His studio, Arcanaut, works in six-month cycles of big milestones.
There's still no release date and no confirmed platforms. 2027 is also Star Wars' 50th anniversary.
